It cites a joint FBI and NSA advisory on these campaigns. It recommends setting DMARC to quarantine or reject, using AI-driven email protection, and training staff.

59b4660c9819d21d97621fadcac9e93be556164c.summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant report BRICKSTORM, a backdoor written in Go and used in intrusions into US organisations. They attribute the activity to UNC5221 and related suspected China-nexus clusters, which target legal services, SaaS providers, outsourcers and technology firms. The backdoors sit on network appliances and VMware vCenter/ESXi hosts that lack EDR, with SOCKS proxying and cloning of domain controllers. Average dwell time was 393 days. Mail is read through Microsoft 365 enterprise applications. The report offers an asset inventory, hunt steps and hardening…
